```{r}
#| message: FALSE 

library(tabr)

movable_do <- function(solfege_str, key = "C", octave = 3) {
  # offsets in semitones relative to Do
  semitone_map <- c(
    "do" = 0, "di" = 1,
    "ra" = 1, "re" = 2, "ri" = 3,
    "me" = 3, "mi" = 4,
    "fa" = 5, "fi" = 6,
    "se" = 6, "so" = 7, "sol" = 7, "si" = 8,
    "le" = 8, "la" = 9, "li" = 10,
    "te" = 10, "ti" = 11
  )
  
  c_notes <- c("c", "d_", "d", "e_", "e", "f", "f#", "g", "a_", "a", "b_", "b")
  
  # Extract the tonic from the key 
  tonic <- tolower(sub("m$", "", key))
  key_offsets <- c(
    "c" = 0,
    "c#" = 1, "d_" = 1,
    "d" = 2, 
    "d#" = 3, "e_" = 3,
    "e" = 4, 
    "f" = 5,
    "f#" = 6, "g_" = 6,
    "g" = 7, 
    "g#" = 8, "a_" = 8,
    "a" = 9, 
    "a#" = 10, "b_" = 10,
    "b" = 11
  )
  
  shift <- key_offsets[tonic]
  if (is.na(shift)) stop("Invalid key. Use tabr format like 'g', 'b_', 'f#', or 'am'.")
  
  oct_diff <- octave - 3
  base_ocr_str <- if (oct_diff > 0) {
    strrep("'", oct_diff)
  } else if (oct_diff < 0) {
    strrep(",", abs(oct_diff))
  } else {
    ""
  }
  
  tokens <- strsplit(trimws(solfege_str), "\\s+")[[1]]
  
  converted <- sapply(tokens, function(tok) {
    syllable <- tolower(sub("[^a-zA-Z].*$"), "", tok)
    extra_oct <- sub("^[a-zA-Z]+", "", tok)
    
    if (syllable == "r") return(paste0("r", extra_oct))
    
    semi <- semitone_map[syllable]
    if (is.na(semi)) stop(paste("Unkown sylablle:", syllable))
    
    paste0(c_notes[semi + 1], base_oct_str, extra_oct)
  })
  
}
```
